current.text: Yves Missi is expected to start at center for New Orleans. Queen looks set to come off the bench.
The Pelicans have a crowded frontcourt and wing rotation: Zion Williamson, Trey Murphy, Herb Jones, Yves Missi, Jeremiah Fears and Dejounte Murray, with Bennedict Mathurin added to the bench.
Experts think Queen and Zion Williamson do not fit together. His minutes depend on how new coach Jamahl Mosley handles it, and he will likely share the second unit.
Experts have moved him down because he is unlikely to start. If he comes off the bench, his current draft spot is a little early.
He has top 50 upside if he becomes the starting center or Zion Williamson misses time. Josh expects the Pelicans to rest Zion often.
He is an acceptable flyer at his price.

durable.text: He is a hub big who works from the elbows and the free throw line. He is not a three-point spacer.
He is a poor defender and gives little rim protection.
He is a poor shooter but fills the stat sheet, with good rebounds, assists, steals and blocks for a big.
He does not give the FG% boost you want from a center.
He makes few threes and commits many turnovers for his position.
He tends to start games slowly and produce most in fourth-quarter runs.

note: Yahoo ranks him 96 (value 5 USD) and ESPN 95 (average cost 1.7 USD). That puts him at the end of a 144-player draft, so he is a 1 to 3 USD flyer, not a planned starter. His rebounds, assists, steals and blocks fit punt 3PM and punt TO builds, but his FG% gives no boost for a big. Early in the season, check whether Missi keeps the starting job and how often Zion sits, because his top 50 upside depends on one of those changing.
